title: Chintamani Library v2.8.16 — Universal QR Portal & Admin Portal Synchronization
releaseNotes: UNIVERSAL QR PORTAL & ADMIN SYNC: Permanent end-to-end integration between Universal QR Portal and Admin Portal for both Khalilabad and Mehdawal branches.
BRANCH-WISE PAYMENT VERIFICATIONS: Added branch filtering (All, Khalilabad, Mehdawal) and branch badges on Payment Verifications with immediate live reaction to branch switcher.
NEW REGISTRATIONS & COMPLAINTS SYNC: Registrations and complaints submitted from the Universal QR Portal now reliably persist to database and sync seamlessly to Admin Portal.
RESPONSE PARSING REPAIR: Corrected API payload envelope extraction for registration, payment, attendance, and complaint submissions.
ADMIN PORTAL ACCESS & JWT REFRESH: Updated web admin portal with secure login, dynamic authentication token handling, and robust branch slug resolution.
